description: Daily Shelter & Overnight Service Occupancy & Capacity is a dataset listed in City of Toronto open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Toronto. This data set provides a daily list of active overnight shelter and allied services in the Toronto Shelter and Support Services division's Shelter Management Information System (SMIS) database. The data provides daily updated information about shelter and overnight service programs administered by TSSS including the program's operator, location, classification, occupancy and capacity. Coverage: Toronto. The portal files it under the publisher City of Toronto. Its tags are shelter. It offers 24 resource(s) in CSV, JSON, XML. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-toronto-portal.
